title: Kyler Murray, Jordan Addison put Vikings up 17-10 at halftime

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyler Murray, Jordan Addison put Vikings up 17-10 at halftime
sources.description: The Vikings lost Justin Jefferson to an ankle injury during the first half of Sunday's game in Tampa, but another wide receiver stepped up to make sure they went into halftime with a lead.
